items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Buster Bailey, a tremendous clarinet, you know, -- INTERVIEWEE: Oh, yeah, he was wonderful.

ctx.x: -- and Buster Harding used to be in New York? And Calloway would call up Buster and we used to say Buster was head of the farm system.
Yeah. "Pull out another guy right away."
